introHtml: Custom lanyards and badges with hood provide a convenient way to protect ID cards and access passes from dust and scratches. The built-in hood keeps badges clean and readable, making them ideal for outdoor events, manufacturing sites, or any environment where cards need extra protection. Choose from knit-in, woven, or recycled lanyard styles and add your logo with screen printing or full-color dye sublimation.
